title: A frozen input (flotilla input schema, version 1)
description: What flotillad handed a live run when it started, so a shadow version of the routine, a replay or an eval can be given exactly that. The same envelope is a scenario's start: a captured live input exports as this envelope, with the ledger rows as of its mark and the state snapshot (a file beside it), written to a folder outside any repository, and is production data until the installation scrubs it. The fields only a live capture has (the ledger marks, the live case keys, the state snapshot, the commit) are optional, so an input built from a dataset item validates too. recorded_tool_results: per station name, the calls and results of a captured run or a scenario's fixtures, matched by station, tool name and normalised arguments, never by sequence (runtime/recorded.py: the normalisation; a key recorded once answers every repeat of it, a key recorded several times answers in order and the last repeats, a key never recorded fails the run and is never sent live).

input_key.description: The live run's id, which every shadow record of this input carries as its pairing key.

kind.description: How the live run was started: on its schedule or by hand (tick), on a case, to check a case's outcome, or to execute its decided plan.

version.description: The routine's version the live run was.

trigger.description: schedule, manual, case, check or execute.

started_at.description: When the live run started (UTC, RFC 3339).

tick_time.description: The moment a scheduled run was for.

case.description: The case the run was handed (its FLOTILLA_CASE).

plan.description: The plan an execute run was handed (its FLOTILLA_PLAN).

check.description: What a check run was asked to verify (its FLOTILLA_CHECK).

resume.description: The earlier run of the case this one may continue (its FLOTILLA_RESUME).

commit.description: For a routine that works on a repository: the commit flotillad resolved at dispatch and handed to the live run and to its shadows.

ledger.description: The routine's ledger as of the run's start: the high-water marks (the newest sequence numbers of its filings and decisions then) and, in an export that asked for them, the rows up to them.

filings.description: The current filed rows as of the mark, in ledger order.

entries.description: The decisions and recurrences as of the mark, in ledger order.

live_case_keys.description: The canonical keys of the open cases of the kinds the routine detects, when the run started: what a monitor's detections are compared with.

state_snapshot.description: The routine's own state (files it keeps, such as a ledger file) as the live worker snapshotted it when the run started: the paths, relative to the worker's HOME, and, in an export that asked for it, the tar.gz beside the envelope.

tar.description: The archive's file name, in the folder the envelope was exported to.

recorded_tool_results.description: Per station name, the recorded calls and results of the tools the runtime serves (harness flotilla's tool names).

result.description: What the tool returned, any JSON value.
